title: Manual test bench
description: The cases a person, or a certifier, walks. Derived from acceptance scenarios: one or more cases per scenario, never a case without one. Keep the bench as data (a JSON file, or a script block of type application/json inside a bench page) so a test can parse all of it; see bench-contract.test.mjs.

id.description: Stable and unique: B-01, B-02. Never renumber; certification reports cite these.

group.description: An id from groups. Put the read-only seed cases in the first group.

actor.description: The role who performs the steps: member, steward, anonymous visitor.

story.description: The story and scenario this case proves, e.g. F003-US2-4 (feature 003, story 2, scenario 4). Several, separated by ' · ', when one case covers more than one.

steps.description: What a person does, starting from where they land. A URL appears only when the case is about a link.

expected.description: What is visible on the screen or in the API response when the case holds: values, states, messages, counts, the exact numbers the seed produces.

ref.description: Optional: the requirement or decision behind it.

note.description: Optional: what changes after other cases ran, what state this one consumes.
